title: US higher-education long-tail (chunk 1): state flagships, major publics, notable privates + HBCUs
source: Public record: IPEDS / Carnegie Classification (institution existence); NSF HERD + federal-R&D + UARC records for the documented ties. Catalog COVERAGE layer (#203). Structural overlay; flat enumeration - most nodes carry only a 'member' edge to the US_Higher_Education hub; specific ties added only where documented. All under the 'academia' bucket (hideable via the bubble-map Layers panel).
grade: institution existence = FACT; the hub 'member' edges are enumeration, not relationship claims; the handful of signal edges (Penn State ARL, Texas A&M, UMD ARLIS, Purdue, ASU, JHU APL) = FACT.
honest_limits: This is a COVERAGE layer, not exhaustive (US has ~4,000 degree-granting institutions; this chunk is ~85 flagships/majors/notable privates/HBCUs). Community colleges, for-profits, and the small-college long-tail are NOT included - adding thousands of single-edge nodes would dilute the map (hence the Layers toggle to hide 'academia'). Further chunks can extend coverage.

US higher education is a major recipient of federal research funding (NSF/NIH/DoD/DOE) + student aid - the systemic academia<->state tie (fact).
Penn State's Applied Research Laboratory is a Navy University-Affiliated Research Center (UARC) - major defense R&D (fact).
Texas A&M runs major nuclear + defense + hypersonics research (Bush Combat Dev Complex; nuclear engineering) (fact).
UMD hosts IC/defense-adjacent research (ARLIS UARC; proximity to NSA/agencies) (fact).
Purdue is a semiconductor + hypersonics + AI research hub (SK Hynix Indiana packaging; Purdue Computes) (fact).
ASU - largest US public university + heavy online/AI-in-education + OpenAI enterprise deal (2024) (fact).
(core node) JHU Applied Physics Lab is the largest US UARC - defense/space; noted for cross-link (fact).
